$comment: D443 T6 voice and excitement (services/clip/excitement.py post-stream, services/event-core/voice-marks.mjs live). Every threshold, weight and window here is a first proposal, not measured on the user's voice or streams: status unverified, approvedBy null. Event weights need the user's approval (AGENTS.md: never invented as final). Marker phrases are the user's own answer of 2026-11-24 (Malayalam script, Manglish Latin spellings, English); a phrase only marks the moment, it never acts on the stream.

phrases.note: latin: matched as whole words after lower-casing; runs of 3 or more equal letters fold to one or two (adipoliii = adipoli, suuuper = super), runs of 2 are kept (supper is not super); a variant with a space must appear as adjacent words. malayalam: after Unicode NFC, matched at a word start; endings may follow only where malayalamSuffix is true (സൂപ്പർമാർക്കറ്റ് is not സൂപ്പർ). Forcing (D443 T6 marker forcing): a Malayalam-script hit always forces a clip; a Latin hit forces only where forceLatin is true. English scene and super are common words (game audio, teammates), so they add score only.

voice.note: Per second of the recording's audio: loudness (RMS dBFS) and pitch (autocorrelation, voiced 50 ms frames) against the speaker's own rolling baseline (median/MAD of the earlier voiced seconds). A rise of zFull MADs or more counts as 1.

events.note: Laughter and shouting from the YAMNet audio-event model (download item audio-events, CPU only). Class indexes from yamnet_class_map.csv at the pinned revision. A per-second probability of full or more counts as 1.

chat.note: Chat rate over windowSec against the session median; ratio x median (at least minMessages) counts as 1.

weights.note: Share of each part in the per-second excitement score (0..1). Proposal; needs the user's approval.

rank.note: Post-stream: a second keeps its score only when at least minParts parts reach partLevel there (one part alone, e.g. loud game audio, never counts). A second whose score reaches threshold opens a 'voice.excitement' event (strength = score). A forcing phrase (forceLatin, or any Malayalam-script hit) opens 'voice.phrase', which makes a clip even below ranking minScore; any other phrase hit (English scene, super) opens 'voice.word', score only. At most one of each per minGapSec. Weights are on the scale of data/clip/ranking.json weights.

live.note: Live (not wired: no live transcriber exists yet): a marker phrase in a live transcript line writes one host marker (source audio, note 'voice: marker phrase <id> forced|word'), at most one per phrase per minGapSec and one in total per anyGapSec; a host call that does not answer in hostTimeoutMs frees its slot. Post-stream these markers become voice.phrase / voice.word events (clip_signals.read_markers), never a force-kept marker.audio. Never acts on the stream.
